name: C-T
source:
A worrywart and a skeptic surgeon who acts like a nurse and the Doctor's assistant. He is pretty dependable, probably.

[spoiler]His real name is Carlos Tompkins. He is very loyal to the Doctor to a fault and may do things that no one will imagine him doing.[/spoiler]
